candidates.possible_sharing_reason: All Message features consume source-addressable candidate evidence and preserve it into a structural result.
semantic_merge_risks: The required identities and roles differ per feature.
Some features have reservations, others external-provider status or no routed unresolved identifiers.
Pair, catalogue, cycle, AST, claim, and profile structures have different observable contracts.
candidates.proposed_decision: Keep local until at least one additional domain demonstrates equivalent evidence-envelope semantics beyond the already reused global shared contracts.

candidates.possible_sharing_reason: Multiple structural features require exact source-defined populations before successful construction.
semantic_merge_risks: Error codes and cardinalities are feature-specific.
MESSAGE-005 requires two same-label occurrences to remain distinct.
MESSAGE-006 also validates relation endpoints and forbidden fields.
candidates.proposed_decision: Retain feature-local population contracts; consider a future generic validation profile only if it can parameterize errors, relations, contextual constraints, and preservation obligations without semantic loss.

candidates.possible_sharing_reason: Both features derive deterministic structural outputs from authoritative recorded source order rather than incidental input order.
semantic_merge_risks: MESSAGE-004 preserves order independently inside each source context and explicitly infers no order between contexts.
MESSAGE-005 exposes one six-stage source order plus four partitions and prohibits transition semantics.
A shared abstraction could falsely equate catalogue order with cycle-stage order.
candidates.proposed_decision: Do not merge. Revisit only with explicit order-scope parameters and cross-domain evidence that distinguishes context-local order from ordered stage references.
